_source: html-prototype: projects/newman-air/design-source (V2 homepage, picked by the team 2026-10-06), palette re-read from Jessica's final logo files (Drive, 2026-10-14/15)
_note: Skeleton from scripts/analyze-prototype.py, hand-tuned 2026-10-20. Colours follow the final logo SVGs, not the V2 prototype (V2 predates the logo). The new site has no kit yet: `global` ids are Elementor's four system colours, which every kit has; set them in Site Settings > Global Colors to the hex below.

teal._from: logo fur highlight; current kit Primary #47BFAF

deep_teal._from: logo fur shadow; replaces the old kit Secondary #006F79

navy._from: logo outline and wordmark stroke; current kit Text

orange._from: logo outer stroke: the Tennessee orange the client asked for (2026-10-07)

gold._from: logo eye/inner orange; old kit Accent

mist._from: current kit grey; small print on dark bands

hero_gradient._note: navy to deeper navy. Deep teal #0F5B6D was tried as a stop and fails AA under the orange eyebrow (3.2:1).

type_scale._from: V2 census: h1 43.2-86.4px fluid, .hero .lead 19.2px, body 17px, eyebrow tracking 0.14em. Collapsed to fixed steps.

button._from: V2 .btn-accent: pill (999px), 2px border, 1.25rem 2.2rem, hover darkens 14% and lifts 2px (Elementor 'float'). Fill moved from #FFA300 to the final orange.

links._note: Sitetree slugs not received yet (Manuel, 86bcajg24). The splash page has no links by brief.
